basis: Presentation-only shell selection (TASK-048). Native RO menu/item icons and monster atlases chosen from local metadata; not gameplay data and not part of content_hash. No new manual visual review beyond the 2026-10-20 contact sheet of ro_menu_icon.

farm.note: Ambient farm waves on the main screen run the shared combat engine for display only. Rewards stay the server farm accrual; waves never grant or change rewards.

wardrobe.note: Visible headgear/garment chosen by the equipped item tier (D-055). Stats come only from equipment data; armor/shoes/accessory stay invisible like RO.

boss_pools.note: Story boss look for non-final stages (D-056): stats/skills stay the stage boss row; the chapter-final stage keeps its authored boss sprite.
